extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users: program directors/principal investigators (PD/PIs), signing officials (SOs), and agency staff managing Just-in-Time (JIT), No-Cost Extension (NCE), and additional materials workflows
extracted.subtask_short: responding to JIT requests in eRA Commons
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and requirements for preparing, uploading, saving, reviewing, and submitting Just-in-Time (JIT) materials (and related Status-module actions such as NCEs and Additional Materials) through the eRA Commons Status module for NIH/VA/AHRQ awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIT submission only when requested
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should not submit any JIT information until and unless they receive a specific request from their awarding agency that a JIT submission is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The JIT link becomes available for all applications that are scored during peer review, but do not submit until an award-specific request is received via the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can upload vs who can submit
rubrics_metrics.description: The program director/principal investigator (PD/PI) and the signing official (SO) work together to complete and submit information for different types of information requests directly to the funding agency. JIT capabilities cannot be delegated. If you have the PI role, you may upload and save JIT information; however, you must be an SO to submit it to the funding agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A PI can upload, save, and view the JIT report but cannot click Submit. Only an SO (or TTO if no SO assigned in some contexts) can submit JIT material to the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: PII/PHI redaction requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personally identifiable information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI) should be redacted from all documents you are uploading via JIT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove or redact PII/PHI before upload to avoid transmitting protected information in JIT submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required PDF format and file size limit
rubrics_metrics.description: All JIT attachments must be submitted in PDF format with a maximum size of 6MB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each upload area can accept only a single PDF. If you re-upload a file, it replaces the previous file. The PDF size requirement is enforced on upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flattened PDF requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: PDF uploads for all sections are required to be a flattened PDF (one that does not have fillable forms or other layers, such as movable images).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you attempt to upload and save a file that is not flattened you will see: "Error Uploading PDF. Please ensure all files are flattened...." Suggested flattening method: print to PDF (choose “Print to PDF” in Acrobat) to create a flattened file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single file per upload area / replacement behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Each upload area can accept only a single PDF, and if you re-upload a file for a given JIT section, it replaces the previous file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All elements on the JIT form can be submitted multiple times and will be appended to the JIT report, with the latest version at the top of the report. For per-section behavior, the newly uploaded file replaces the existing file for that upload button.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIT report concatenation/appending
rubrics_metrics.description: All elements on the JIT form can be submitted multiple times and will be appended to the JIT report, with the latest version at the top of the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: View the concatenated Just In Time Report (PDF) to see what will be submitted; the report may not include previously submitted files that are not slated in the current submit action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Saving vs submitting and confirmations
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can save an in-progress JIT by clicking Save; SOs submit all uploaded files to the agency by clicking Submit. Saving does not submit to the awarding agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When saving a JIT a confirmation displays that you are about to save but not submit and that an SO must submit to the awarding agency. When submitting, SOs receive a Submit Confirmation popup and (for SBIR/STTR foreign disclosure) an additional 'I Agree/Submit' acceptance in some cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission allowed until approval
rubrics_metrics.description: You can resubmit JIT information as many times as necessary. Each section of the JIT information can be submitted separately and more than once.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can continue to upload a file to a section and resubmit as long as the agency has not yet approved that particular section. After submission, the Number of Submissions updates per section.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIT action visibility/window
rubrics_metrics.description: The JIT action is removed once an application has been awarded. For VA applicants, you have 180 days to submit the requested material after receiving the JIT email alert.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs and SOs receive email alerts for JIT requests. Do not expect the JIT link to remain after award; it is removed upon award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section-specific availability (SBIR/STTR, DMS, Human/Animal Subjects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain JIT sections appear only for relevant awards: SBIR STTR Foreign Disclosure Form for certain small business awards; Data Management and Sharing (DMS) Plan Revision for awards subject to the DMS Policy; Human Subject Information only for awards involving human subjects; Animal Subjects Information only for awards involving vertebrate animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the categories and secondary sites configured by agency staff for the JIT request will appear on the JIT screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects IRB date validation and assurance number requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The IRB date is validated such that the IRB date must be in the range of one year previous to today's date. If you enter an IRB date, you must also select an assurance number from the dropdown list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the Assurance Number dropdown is empty, contact your signing official to have the Human Subjects Assurance (HSA) number entered in the Institution Profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal subjects IACUC date validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the IACUC date, which should be within the last three years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See The IACUC guidance (link provided) for details about care and use of vertebrate animals; the JIT enforces the three-year window for IACUC date entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special file handling for SciENcv-produced forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Biographical Sketch Common Form and Current and Pending (Other) Support Common Form that were produced in SciENcv must not be flattened or modified after they are produced in SciENcv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload the SciENcv-produced files as-is if requested. Modifying or flattening these SciENcv files after generation is discouraged/forbidden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign Contract CPS requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload a flattened PDF file of the Foreign Contract document if the Senior/Key person has contracts specific to foreign appointments and/or employment with a foreign organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure this file is flattened PDF (no fillable fields) per general JIT PDF rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR Foreign Disclosure Form appearance and policy linkage
rubrics_metrics.description: The SBIR STTR Foreign Disclosure Form section appears ONLY for SBIR/STTR awards (list of activity codes). See Required Disclosures of Foreign Affiliations or Relationships to Foreign Countries and referenced NIH guide notice for policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow specific NIH notices and policy guidance linked from the JIT help text when preparing foreign disclosure materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genome Data Sharing Certification upload
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload the Genome Data Sharing Certification if required by the awarding agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only required when agency requests it; follow agency-specific instructions on content.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIT section status badges and meanings
rubrics_metrics.description: Status badges indicate section state: No badge (nothing done), Uploaded (someone uploaded and saved but not submitted), Revision Requested (a file was submitted but returned by agency staff to be revised), Approved (uploaded, submitted, and accepted by the awarding agency).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use badge states and last-uploaded filename/date to verify readiness before submitting; badges help determine whether agency action is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-section Number of Submissions vs Total Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of Submissions shows how many times a file has been submitted for a particular section. Total Submissions under Application Information indicates the total number of times an SO has clicked Submit for the JIT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each section can have a different number of submissions; per-section number is independent of the application-wide Total Submissions count.

rubrics_metrics.name: History view shows only actual submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: History includes file name, submit date, status, comment, and person who uploaded the file. Until a file for the section has been submitted, History is blank, as it only shows history of actual submissions, not uploads or saves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the History popup to audit submissions; it will not show saved-but-not-submitted uploads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency comments and decision attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency staff can add comments during approval or rejection of submissions (appear in Comment field). After submittal, agency staff can approve, return, or disapprove a section and upload a document as part of the approval/return/disapproval; that file will then reside in the Agency Decision Attachment field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hover over Additional Agency Comments to view agency-entered instructions; check Agency Decision Attachment after agency review for documents provided by the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing uploaded files
rubrics_metrics.description: To view a file that has already been uploaded, click its Download icon; the file will download or open in a browser according to browser settings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior to submitting, reviewers should click file names or download files and/or use the View Just In Time Report to preview concatenated submission contents.

rubrics_metrics.name: View Just In Time Report behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking View Just In Time Report downloads a concatenated PDF that contains all uploaded files that will be submitted if you click the Submit button. This does not necessarily contain all files, only those slated to be submitted at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Previously submitted files may not appear in the current concatenated report; use Status Information screen to view all prior submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Saving does not submit and can be used to collaborate
rubrics_metrics.description: Saving stores an in-progress JIT so others (e.g., SO) can work on it later; saving does not submit anything to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PI can save uploaded files and notify SO to review/submit; SO must log in to actually Submit JIT materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not delegate JIT capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: JIT capabilities cannot be delegated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only users assigned the PI or SO roles in eRA Commons have the described JIT abilities; delegation of the JIT capability is not permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: No-Cost Extension (NCE) core eligibility conditions (NIH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awardees may extend the final budget period of the project when the following conditions are met: If no additional funds are required from the NIH awarding office; If there will be no change in the project’s originally approved scope; If no term of award specifically prohibits the extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additionally, an extension may be appropriate when additional time is needed to complete the project, continuity is needed while a competing continuation is under review, or to permit an orderly phase-out of a project that will not receive continued support.

rubrics_metrics.name: NCE procedural constraints and timing (NIH)
rubrics_metrics.description: The NCE is initiated in the Status module by using the Extension action, which appears for signing officials (SOs) only, 90 days before the project end date and is removed at midnight on the project end date; it appears ONLY if the project period was NOT previously extended by the awarding office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an Extension Error appears (internal business error), instructions are provided on whom to contact; once corrected the NCE will be processed and notifications sent.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHRQ-specific NCE rules
rubrics_metrics.description: AHRQ grants under expanded authorities include the provision for grantees to automatically extend the final budget period one time for up to 12 months without additional AHRQ funds and without prior approval. AHRQ requires grantees to use the No-Cost Extension feature in the Status module for automatic first-time approvals and will not accept requests via other channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To request the one-time AHRQ automatic extension, select months for extension, acknowledge terms (including updating required certifications), and click Request Extension. Do not use Prior Approval module for first-time AHRQ NCEs; consult AHRQ link for additional guidance or for second extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Institution — Relinquishing Statements via Status module
rubrics_metrics.description: The Change of Institution process in eRA Commons allows extramural grantee institutions to submit Relinquishing Statements (RS) electronically via Commons. The Relinquishing Statement screens are accessible via the Status module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relinquishing Statements are official documents relinquishing interests and rights to PHS research grants and typically accompany change of organization/successor-in-interest requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unfunded Application Notification visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will send centralized automated correspondence to applicant organizations notifying them of NIH’s intent not to fund indicated applications; the consolidated email will be sent by eRA Commons to AOR and SO and the Notice of Award email address, approximately 14 months after the application’s council date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorized eRA Commons users (PIs, SOs, delegated Assistants) can see if an unfunded application notification has been sent for a specific application by viewing the Status Information; external users cannot view content of the notification through eRA Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Materials Requests workflow (OT and others)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some award types (e.g., Other Transactions) allow grantees to upload and submit additional materials to the funding agency using Add Additional Materials action in the Status module. Contact principal investigators (PI) can start the process by uploading requested documents and notifying the SO, who then must log into eRA Commons and approve by submitting to the agency. Only signing officials can actually submit additional materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PI can add files and enter comments (viewable by agency staff) and click Notify SO; SO sees Submit and can edit before final submission. After submission, agency may return submissions if insufficient and will provide rationale in the Submissions by Awardee view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission status values for Additional Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission statuses visible on the Status Information screen include: Submitted (submitted but not yet evaluated by agency) and Rejected (submitted and not accepted by agency due to insufficiencies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click View to read agency comments explaining rejection/required changes in the Submission by Awardee section.
